question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between

Chicken, Vegetarian food, and Non-vegetarian food.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ac5eaf32617629b4b1ecce5c1260c9d919c56e7f6c3c597100d36c4494fa84a.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f20f8d324a490cf12b95231493fa263fceaa2dc07dcfbd10e104d4ffcb10130.png] 

As Chicken is a part of Non-vegetarian food, so Chicken will come inside Non-vegetarian food.

Vegetarian food is neither related to Chicken nor to Non-vegetarian food, so it'll have a separate circle.

Hence, option 1) is the correct answer.
